newsitem.title: UK: Mobil to sell London office, may raise 50 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Mobil to sell London office, may raise 50 mln stg.

text.p: U.S. oil major Mobil Corp said it is planning to put its London premises, Mobil Court, up for sale next year.
The sale of the 175,000 square-foot office building in central London could raise 50 million stg, commercial property agents said on Friday.
"It would fetch more in the City but even so there should be a lot of competition for it," said one.
Mobil Court currently houses 850 staff, including Mobil North Sea exploration and production staff as well as shipping and supply and trading departments, a Mobil spokesman said.

"Changes in our business, such as the joint venture with British Petroleum (BP) and the recent worldwide restructuring of our staff support services, will result in fewer London-based employees in the near future," said Hal Cramer, president Mobil Europe and Asia Ltd.
"In general, it is Mobil policy worldwide to rent accommodation for our employees at a competitive cost," Cramer said.
Mobil said it would be seeking rented accommodation in the Greater London area. The move is unlikely to occur before 1998.
